subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
11. 
A manufacturer of industrial fasteners produces high-strength bolts. Last year, they sold 
35,000 bolts at a price of ` 50 each. Their total fixed cost was ` 7,50,000 (including  
` 2,50,000 depreciation on machinery) incurred uniformly throughout the year. There was 
no inventory at the beginning and all bolts produced during the year were shipped out, 
resulting in no inventory at the end of the year. The company’s cash break-even point is 
20,000 bolts. 
 
Calculate the amount of total variable costs incurred. 
(A)  
` 8,57,000 
(B)  
` 8,75,000 
(C)  
` 4,37,500 
(D)  
` 4,73,500 
(2 Marks)
suggested_answer: (B) ` 8,75,000 Cash Break-even Sales Quantity = Fixed Costs (excluding dep.) Contribution per unit 20,000 units = (` 7,50,000 - ` 2,50,000) Contribution per unit Contribution per unit = ` 5,00,000 /20,000 = ` 25 Variable Cost per unit = Selling Price per unit – Contribution per unit = ` 50 - ` 25 = ` 25 Total Variable cost = 25 x 35,000 = ` 8,75,000
